organ: the arena watched and the tournament: a duel replayed case by case to its own receipt and read back by the rules that fired, and a bracket decided only by its duel receipts
disclosure: Not fully blind: before this seal, on 2026-10-22, tools/measure-12.mjs was dry-run with SMALL=1 (2 duels a business, brackets of 4, 50 receipt sets) to test the tooling. Only its properties were read (all held); no duel’s winner, no tally of cases called right and no bracket’s champion was read. Organ 12 reads no TEST row at all.
population: the five businesses whose drop has cards in two or more departments: 20 kit duels per business between genesis cards handed to demo owners (the challenger with 0 to 2 nodes of other departments, the defender alone, of the challenger’s department), each replayed and every case read back; one bracket per business of 8 genesis cards, each with its own demo owner, every match fought as a duel; and 1,000 seeded receipt sets of 2 to 16 entrants with draws, junk and duels of one owner against itself

rules.claim: Every one of the 100 duels replays to the very same receipt; its cases, laid out, give back the receipt’s two AUCs exactly; and each side calls exactly as many yeses as the batch holds real yeses.

On every case of every replayed duel, each fielded mind’s read-back gives the very score the duel used for it, and for every mind of one department the weights of its rules that fired sum to that score.

Across the 1,000 receipt sets every bracket plays out the same however its entrants are listed; every decided match is decided by the first receipt, in order, naming exactly its two cards that is not a draw; no match is decided while a side of it is open; a champion is named exactly when the final is decided, its title practice exactly when a deciding duel was one owner against itself; and all 5 real brackets play out to a champion that is no practice champion.
In at least 80% of the decided duels whose sides called different numbers of cases right, the side that called more right also has the higher AUC: the watched-back tally agrees with the receipt.

In the 5 real brackets, the card with the higher declared GATE AUC wins at least 60% of the matches between cards of different declared AUC: the arena’s 64 cases reflect the score a card was proven on.
